cards.audioText: What is meant by a high-altitude airport?
cards.referenceText: A high-altitude airport is an airport located far enough above sea level for reduced air density to have an important operational effect. The exact threshold used for a label can differ, so pilots rely on the airport elevation and aircraft performance data rather than the name alone. High temperature can further raise density altitude and worsen performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 高高原机场是海拔较高、空气密度降低已对运行产生重要影响的机场。具体称谓采用的高度标准可能不同，因此飞行员应依据机场标高和飞机性能数据，而不能只看名称。高温会进一步提高密度高度，使性能变差。

cards.audioText: If you had to land at the high-altitude airport shown, how would you prepare for a safe arrival?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果必须在图中所示的高海拔机场着陆，你会如何为安全到达做准备？
cards.referenceText: I would review airport elevation, terrain, weather, runway condition and approach or missed-approach gradients and calculate landing and go-around performance for the expected mass. The briefing would cover higher true airspeed and groundspeed, visual illusions, engine and brake limitations, oxygen or pressurization considerations and escape options. I would arrive stabilized with adequate fuel and use another airport if the required margins were not available.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会检查机场标高、地形、天气、跑道状况、进近和复飞梯度，并按预计重量计算着陆和复飞性能。简令会包括较高的真空速和地速、目视错觉、发动机和刹车限制、供氧或增压注意事项，以及脱离方案。我会在燃油充足的情况下以稳定状态进近；如果没有规定的安全裕度，就改用其他机场。

cards.audioText: What challenges do pilots face when operating at high-altitude airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 在高海拔机场运行时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: Low air density reduces engine, propeller, rotor and wing performance and increases true airspeed for a given indicated speed. Takeoff and landing distances may be longer, climb and go-around capability lower, and terrain clearance more demanding. High groundspeed, weather, hypoxia risk and reduced braking or cooling margins can add workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空气密度低会降低发动机、螺旋桨、旋翼和机翼性能，并使相同指示空速对应的真空速更高。起飞和着陆距离可能增加，爬升和复飞能力降低，越障也更具挑战。较高地速、天气、缺氧风险，以及制动或冷却裕度减小，都会增加工作负荷。
